name: @caotang/import-read
description: The readers every import shares: a namespace-aware XML reader with no DOMParser, and a zip and folder reader over fflate's unzipSync with size, ratio, entry and path caps; and the plain-text reader (any common encoding, through the store's detection) that emits the shared import blocks. Runs on the main thread, in a 'self' Worker and in Node.
